definitions.explanation: The degree or quality of being hot to the touch. Refers to the temperature of objects, liquids, or food.
Figurative heat — the intensity of emotions, enthusiasm, or devotion.

examples.japanese: ⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熱|あつ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was startled by how hot the soup was.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熱|あつ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ちょうどいい→ちょうどいい：21521_choudoii⟧。
examples.english: The tea is just the right temperature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鉄板|てっぱん}→鉄板：14470_teppan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熱|あつ}さ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やけどしそうになった。
examples.english: I almost burned my hand on the hot iron plate.

examples.japanese: ⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熱|あつ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by the fans' passion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熱|あつ}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧だ。
examples.english: His passion for work is genuine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}{運動|うんどう}→選挙運動：26087_senkyoundou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熱|あつ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ま}している→増す：02422_masu⟧。
examples.english: The intensity of the election campaign is growing day by day.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧ (hot to the touch). Formed with the suffix ～さ, which converts adjectives into nouns indicating degree.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱|あつ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧: to endure the heat
- {熱|あつ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel the heat
- {熱|あつ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷|さ}める→冷める：02114_sameru⟧: for the heat/passion to cool down

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧: heat (weather) — refers to hot weather, not the temperature of objects
- {厚|あつ}さ: thickness — same pronunciation, completely different meaning
- {温|あたた}かさ: warmth — gentler than {熱|あつ}さ; pleasant rather than intense
